layouts.Name: Black Locust FPO
layouts.Notes:
Out of Bounds (Rule 806.02) - Beyond any marked WHITE line

Players may pull string tight between stakes if the string is loose or broken. 

Casual Area (Rule 806.03) - Marked by BLUE stakes or marked BLUE line

Required Relief Area (Rule 806.04) - Marked by RED stakes or marked RED line. 

Hazard (Rule 806.05) - Marked by YELLOW line and stakes 

Mandatory (Rule 804.01) - Marked by ORANGE line 

Drop Zone - Marked by ORANGE stakes
